card.name: Opioid and pain-drug lists in labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation, linking words and spaces right where a pain-drug name is expected next, such as opioids, narcotic analgesics, antipyretics or antiemetics in label text.

modes.label: Commas in drug lists
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.' just before the next opioid in an interaction list.
modes.example: Narcotic analgesics metabolized by CYP3A: e.g. fentanyl<<,>> oxycodone

modes.label: Linking words before drug names
modes.description: A word like including or oral that leads into a named pain or premedication drug.
modes.example: avoid the use of opioid antitussives,<< including>> Hydrocodone Polistirex and

modes.label: Spaces and section numbers
modes.description: A bare space or repeated section number in dosing and heading text.
modes.example: ( 2.1 ) Administer on an empty stomach, at least 1 hour prior to or 2 hours after a full meal. (<< >>2.1 ) 2.1

card.writes: It suppresses 'par' and 'pain' word starts, and the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese and give no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires at small joining spots in label text about opioids and pain medicines, just before another drug is named.
